description: This file is a Python test module for verifying HTTP authentication behaviors, including digest and basic authentication, using pytest framework. It contains setup fixtures, parameterized tests for different protocols, and checks for server responses when downloading or uploading data with various authentication credentials.

classes.name: TestAuth
classes.description: A test class containing multiple pytest-based test methods for HTTP authentication scenarios.

methods.name: _class_scope(self, env, httpd, nghttpx)
methods.description: Fixture method that runs once per test class to set up environment, start nghttpx if needed, create data files, and reload HTTP server.

methods.name: test_14_01_digest_get_noauth(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test downloading a file without authentication expecting HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

methods.name: test_14_02_digest_get_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test downloading a file with digest authentication expecting HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: test_14_03_digest_put_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test uploading data with digest authentication expecting HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: test_14_04_digest_large_pw(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test digest authentication with a large password, expecting a 401 response due to incorrect password hash.

methods.name: test_14_05_basic_large_pw(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test basic authentication with a large password, expecting HTTP 431 error due to length limits.

methods.name: test_14_06_basic_very_large_pw(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test basic authentication with an extremely large password, expecting a socket error (exit codes 55 or 56).
